subject: cg
question: Explain Composite Transformation in 2-D graphics of following problem: Consider we have a square O (0,0), B(4,0), C(4,4), D(0,4) on which we first apply T1(scaling transformation) given scaling factor is Sx=Sy=0.5 and then we apply T2(rotation transformation in clockwise direction) it by 90o(angle), in last we perform T3(reflection transformation about origin).
title: Composite: scale, rotate, reflect
